en.headline: Police arrest man after finding suspected cocaine in Hung Hom car
en.dek: Officers stopped a private car on Tai Wan Road around 1am on Monday and arrested the driver in his 20s on suspicion of drug trafficking.
body: Police arrested a man in his 20s on suspicion of drug trafficking early on Monday after finding about 20 packets of suspected cocaine in his car in Hung Hom.

Hung Hom task force officers spotted the suspicious private car parked on Tai Wan Road around 1am and stopped it for a search. Officers found the suspected cocaine inside the vehicle and arrested the driver.
The car was later towed away. Police said investigations are continuing.

zh.headline: 紅碣大環道私家車檢獲懷疑可卡因 男司機涉販毒被捕
zh.dek: 警方周一凌晨約一時在紅碣大環道截查一輛私家車，發現約二十包懷疑可卡因，一名二十多歲男司機涉嫌販毒被捕。
body: 警方周一凌晨在紅碣採取行動，一名二十多歲男子因涉嫌販毒被捕，人員在其私家車內發現約二十包懷疑可卡因。
紅碣專案組人員於凌晨約一時在大環道發現可疑私家車，截停後進行搜查，檢獲懷疑可卡因，並拘捕司機。
車輛其後被拖走。警方表示調查仍在進行。
